title: Total stored-state classifier
principal_claim: Every valid retry against one structurally validated stored-state view plus a subject-matching reopen receipt receives one durable class; client transport knowledge remains a separate coordinate.
evidence: five-value durable outcome enum is closed
same commit with changed attempt fingerprint resolves to DEFINITE_REJECTION

commands_not_run_or_blocked: The ordinary Lake command could not use the shared Mathlib build because its lock file is read-only in this sandbox; a direct Lean 4.27 compilation passed against the existing local Mathlib build.
The Lean artifact is an abstract Boolean partition and does not formalize partial reopen value-or-reject semantics or Python refinement.

nonclaims: E04 consumes E01, E02, and E03 verifier-owned research values as premises; it does not implement cryptographic authentication.
The pure classifier performs no datastore I/O and cannot prove transaction isolation, durability, or crash recovery.
The reopen receipt is a structural model port; it does not prove that a production datastore supplied a canonical, fresh, authentic read.
The model does not prove production caller reachability, destination authenticity/idempotency, accounting, backing, zUSD safety, or value movement.
The E04 private registries are model provenance guards and are not a production authentication mechanism.
M6 remains research-only, unmounted, and non-promotable.
